The Drums Agreed to Wait

STS-MS7-L1-1400P-MSVPA-PTN-CFI-01 • MS Visual and Performing Arts Music Grade 7 • Revising Music from Criteria and Feedback
Look at the picture. You will answer some questions about it. Press the play button to hear each question. Record your answer for each question. You can listen to your answer and record it again. Click SUBMIT RECORDINGS when you have answered all the questions.
JUST FOR FUN · OPTIONAL
A treaty is what two sides sign when neither one gets everything it wanted. Mika, Esteban, and Camila brought two music traditions into one room: a taiko drum on one side, a trumpet and a guitarron on the other. Every term on their treaty came from something a classmate wrote on the feedback wall after hearing the first draft, and the criteria board is what they agreed to judge the piece by. Nobody changed the music because they were told to. They changed it because they could say why.
If you wrote the next term of the treaty, what would you change about the piece, and which note on the feedback wall would be your reason?
Optional. You do not have to record this one.
